method: Printed graticule conic fit → independent blue-river/coast similarity registration → typography suppression in classification copy only → colored-area contour tracing → inverse conic transform → GeoJSON WGS84. Original annotations also remapped to Web Mercator.
limitations: Raster color segmentation can miss small islands, cut-outs and labels at narrow borders. Geographic fitting residual is NOT historical accuracy. Original dated sources remain available. No interpolation between years.

byzantine-map-395-en.png.method: Meridian rays and parallel circles fitted to the printed graticule. Radial samples are shared with the ray fit; residual is an internal grid consistency check, not independent geographic validation.

byzantine-theme-map-1025-en.png.notes: Pixel centres snapped to neutral-gray degree-graticule lines; discarded typography-confused intersections. Heldout values were excluded from final parameter estimation. Model is a fitted approximation, not an asserted author CRS.

byzantine-map-1453-en.png.notes: Pixel centres snapped to neutral-gray degree-graticule lines; discarded typography-confused intersections. Heldout values were excluded from final parameter estimation. Model is a fitted approximation, not an asserted author CRS.

byzantine-map-622-en.png.method: Neutral-gray graticule intersection detection with a full ±170 px offset search. Measurements failing either long-line score >20 are excluded. Five clean intersections distributed across all four latitude levels are held out before final fitting. RMS describes pixel registration only, not historical accuracy.

byzantine-theme-map-813-en.png.method: Neutral-gray graticule intersection detection with a full ±170 px offset search. Measurements failing either long-line score >20 are excluded. Five clean intersections distributed across all four latitude levels are held out before final fitting. RMS describes pixel registration only, not historical accuracy.

registration.note: ORB river/coast matches; RANSAC similarity transform. RMS covers consensus matches only, not all mismatches or historical border accuracy.
